boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Northwest University study environments spanning quiet library seating, reservable rooms, computer-equipped spaces, and a campus academic lobby.

cards.title: H-214 Study Space
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library foyer
cards.notes: Bring your NU ID key card and settle in with a laptop or campus computer; tables, seating, a printer, and computers are provided.
cards.short_summary: A key-card study room with computers and printing, typically available around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: NU identifies H-214 as a typically 24-hour, seven-day study space with seating, tables, computers, and a printer.
cards.access_notes: Typically open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week; NU ID key card required. Check the library hours page for closures and exceptions.

cards.title: Hurst Library 1st Floor Seating Area
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library, first floor
cards.notes: Use the library’s first-floor seating for an easy stop between classes, then move upstairs if your work calls for the designated quiet area.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor library seating area beside the 24-hour study room.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University’s campus tour identifies the Hurst Library 1st Floor Seating Area and locates the 24-hour study room nearby.
cards.source_title: Hurst Library 1st Floor Seating Area | Northwest University Campus Tour
cards.access_notes: Library access follows posted library hours; NU ID is required for after-hours and weekend access.

cards.title: Hurst Library 2nd Floor Seating
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library, upper level
cards.notes: Choose the upper-level seating when you want a quieter library setting; keep conversation low and use a study room for collaborative discussion.
cards.short_summary: Upper-level library seating in the floor designated as the quiet area.
cards.evidence_claim: NU’s campus-visit tour describes the library upstairs as the quiet floor, and the campus tour names its 2nd Floor Seating Area.
cards.access_notes: Library access follows posted hours; upper-level library quiet-area expectations apply.

cards.title: Hurst 301 Study Room
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library upper floor
cards.notes: Reserve this room for a focused session, then connect a laptop or use the room computer and wall-mounted display for shared work.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library study room equipped for individual or small-group screen sharing.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists Hurst 301 as a study room with a workstation and wall-mounted HDTV for presentation and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Available during library hours; reservations have priority and NU students, faculty, and staff may reserve rooms for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Hurst 302 Study Room
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library upper floor
cards.notes: Book a two-hour window when you need a contained space for a shared document, presentation practice, or a quiet one-to-two-person session.
cards.short_summary: A reservable Hurst Library room with a workstation and presentation display.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists Hurst 302 as a study room with a workstation and wall-mounted HDTV for presentation and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Available during library hours; reservations have priority and NU students, faculty, and staff may reserve rooms for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Hurst 303 Study Room
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library upper floor
cards.notes: Use the room’s display for a slide review or collaborative screen session, and leave the room reset for the next library user.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped Hurst Library study room for reserved work sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists Hurst 303 as a study room with a workstation and wall-mounted HDTV for presentation and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Available during library hours; reservations have priority and NU students, faculty, and staff may reserve rooms for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Hurst 304 Study Room
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library upper floor
cards.notes: Plan a short reservation for an individual or partner work block, using the workstation and mounted screen to keep materials together.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library study room with built-in computer and display support.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists Hurst 304 as a study room with a workstation and wall-mounted HDTV for presentation and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Available during library hours; reservations have priority and NU students, faculty, and staff may reserve rooms for up to two hours daily.

cards.title: Hurst Library Main-Floor Workstations
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library main floor
cards.notes: Use one of the eight Windows workstations when you need campus software or a library computer, and send documents to the listed library printers.
cards.short_summary: Eight Windows workstations on the library’s main floor with library printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists eight Windows workstations and library printers on the Hurst Library main floor.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Available during posted library hours; visitors may use designated computers with a guest login from the library front desk.

cards.title: Hurst Library Third-Floor Workstations
cards.subtitle: D.V. Hurst Library, third floor
cards.notes: Head upstairs for a library workstation away from the main floor, then use the upstairs printer if you need a hard copy for class.
cards.short_summary: A three-workstation library setup paired with the upstairs printer.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists three Windows workstations on Hurst Library’s third floor and identifies the Library Upstairs Printer.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Available during posted library hours; NU ID is required for after-hours and weekend library access.

cards.title: Rice Hall Lobby Workstations
cards.subtitle: Ness Academic Center, Rice Hall lobby
cards.notes: Use the four lobby workstations for a quick computer-based work block; bring your NU key card because the listed daily access window is controlled.
cards.short_summary: A four-workstation academic-center lobby with a dedicated printer.
cards.evidence_claim: Northwest University lists four Windows workstations and a Rice Lobby Printer in the Ness Academic Center’s Rice Hall Lobby.
cards.source_title: Computer Labs | Northwest University Information Technology Office
cards.access_notes: Listed daily availability is 6:00am–11:00pm by key card; workstations may be unavailable when a class or event is scheduled.
